Hi=20Val=82rie,

I'm=20cc'ing=20my=20reply=20to=20the=20list=20because=20this=20is=20a=20qu=
estion=20people=20commonly=20ask=20
me.=20=20The=20answer=20is=20you=20can=20do=20it=20yourself=20easily!

Send=20a=20message=20to=20
list...@jiscmail.ac.uk

In=20the=20body=20of=20your=20message=20put=20the=20following:
SET=20*=20NOMAIL

This=20will=20stop=20you=20receiving=20mail=20from=20all=20the=20jiscmail=20=
lists=20you=20are=20subscribed=20
to.=20=20When=20you=20get=20back,=20send=20another=20message=20with=20the=20=
following=20in=20the=20body:
SET=20*=20MAIL

This=20puts=20everything=20back=20to=20normal.

There=20are=20lots=20of=20other=20commands=20that=20might=20be=20useful=20=
to=20some=20people=20--=20for=20
example=20there=20is=20an=20option=20to=20have=20messages=20compiled=20int=
o=20a=20digest=20which=20you=20can=20
receive=20at=20a=20time=20interval=20you=20specify=20(once=20a=20day,=20or=
=20once=20a=20week,=20etc).=20=20See=20
http://www.jiscmail.ac.uk/help/commandref.htm=20for=20more=20about=20these=
.
